name: wmtiles-viewer
description: Bundled HTML viewer that ships with `wmtiles serve`. Consumes the wmtiles library + Leaflet for rendering.

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --outfile dist/viewer.js --target browser --format iife --minify
scripts.build:dev: bun build src/main.ts --outfile dist/viewer.js --target browser --format iife --sourcemap=inline
scripts.watch: bun build src/main.ts --outfile dist/viewer.js --target browser --format iife --sourcemap=inline --watch
